customer.shortDescription: Value direct-vent gas fireplace from Kingsman — clean view kit, logs, liner, fan. Practical and reliable.

rep.verificationNotes: For Rockford-area installs, verify whether install address is inside city limits (millivolt ignition restriction). Also confirm a la carte options included/excluded before quote.
rep.liamVoiceCallback: Kingsman — our most sold fireplace every single year by far.
rep.crossSellNotes: If customer wants premium upgrade, walk to position 1 (FPX 564 TV) or position 11 (Kingsman Bentley 39 — bread-and-butter). If wanting modern, position 10 (Kozy Nordik 48TL linear).
rep.displayCallback: Position 4 — Kingsman value path; "available_for_sale" flag set in showroom register.
rep.salesNotes: Kingsman value-direct-vent path. Available for sale (per showroom register). Add-ons (remote, fan kit, lighting, liner/media/front) are a la carte — verify before quoting. HBZDV3628N is part of the broader HBZDV family that Kingsman runs as their builder-volume core.
